summary: defineChatComponent, bindable and refOnly accept zod/v4 schemas of zod 3.25 without exhausting tsc; the generic of ChatComponentDefinition is now the props schema instead of the props shape. zod 3 classic schemas are rejected with a clear error.
howTo: Most apps change nothing. Change explicit generics: ChatComponentDefinition<typeof shape> / ChatComponentDefinitionInput<typeof shape> become ChatComponentDefinition<typeof props> (the z.object(...) schema); for bound props prefer ChatComponentProps<typeof def.props>. A ChatComponentDefinition[] without generic types props only structurally (ChatPropSchema), so call .safeParse on your own schema reference. Apps on zod 3.25: import { z } from 'zod/v4' in chat component modules (plain 'zod' there is zod 3 classic and now throws 'this is a zod 3 schema … import { z } from "zod/v4"'; tools refresh reports chat-component-invalid with the same hint). Remove an alias like "zod-v4": "npm:zod@4…" that only worked around the tsc out-of-memory of 0.31.0. glirastes doctor warns (chat-views-zod) when chat components meet zod 3.
